messages:
frank: heads-up: proposing a short runtime pin to 3.5 for model_group=longformer-quant. observed a memory regression on 3.6-nightly that affects longseq batches — want a guarded pin in staging to validate fix.

deploy-bot: proposed action: pin runtime=3.5 scope=hosted,dedicated duration=90m requestor=frank reason='memory regression on 3.6-nightly for longseq batches'

ops: we need defined rollback triggers and auto-unpin. suggest rollback if p99 token latency > baseline * 1.20 or 5xx rate increases by >0.8%.

runtime: runtime approves conditional on running binary sanity and KV-check; i've kicked ci:sanity --branch=3.5 --check=kv-layout.

sylvia: docs note draft: "Temporary routing to runtime 3.5 for longformer-quant canary window. If you operate long-sequence batching please monitor token-latency and OOMs; we may request small batch-size reductions temporarily."

sre: wiring alerts and dashboard panels now; will paste link. auto-unpin command available.

frank: approvals: runtime+ops? then i'll start 5% canary in eu-west-staging.

ops: approved for eu-west-staging only. global hold until staging passes.

deploy-bot: action: pinned runtime=3.5 for longformer-quant in eu-west-staging at 3456789040 (canary_traffic=5%)

sre: 20m snapshot: one host reported a GPU mem spike but no OOMs; p99 +4%, errors steady. dashboard: https://grafana.internal/r/lfq-pin-canary

frank: ok to expand to 25% in eu-west + 5% in us-east-staging if no new alerts.

deploy-bot: expanded canary at 3456789100 -> eu-west=25% us-east=5%

sre: 45m check: metrics within thresholds, no OOMs. canary looks good.

frank: canary passed. scheduling global unpin-lift tomorrow 02:30-04:00 UTC. will post changelog and runbook link once scheduled.

deploy-bot: schedule-rollout command ready: `/deploybot schedule-rollout --ts=3456877800 --scope=global --note=\"runtime3-5-longformer-quant-rollout\"` (ops final)
